pois.title: Mount Bellig
pois.name: Mount Bellig
pois.desc: === Description === One of the mountains in the Mount Alphus Range. Portals to Mount Gemm and the Bellig Tower can be found to the south of the mountain. === Route ===

pois.title: Mount Alphus
pois.name: Mount Alphus
pois.desc: === Description === The top of one of the Mountains in the Mount Alphus Range, situated around 19.3N, 17.7E. One of the features here is the 19.3N, 17.7E - Mount Alphus Menhir Ring. Also a tent with Zalphoos the Shopkeeper

pois.title: Mount Zabool
pois.name: Mount Zabool
pois.desc: === Description === One of the mountains in the Mount Alphus Range. Unlike the summits of most of the other mountains in the range, Zabool is not reached by using a mountain portal but by instead climbing the Zabool Tower. On the southern end of Zabool is a portal to the northern end of Mount Alphus. The plateau of Alphus may only be reached by using that portal.

pois.title: East Samsur Outpost
pois.name: East Samsur Outpost
pois.desc: === Description === One of the old starter outposts where new arrivals to Dereth would appear. It was destroyed by Martine during The First Strike event. === Route ===

pois.title: Leikotha's Crypt
pois.name: Leikotha's Crypt
pois.desc:
=== Description === A small bunker at 10.1S 31.3E with some shrubbery, occupied by Leikotha and a few less friendly Undead.
This might be the POI indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 47.

pois.title: Nuhmudira's Mansion
pois.name: Nuhmudira's Mansion
pois.desc: === Description === You can get access to Nuhmudira's Dungeon from the mansion's basement. === Route ===

pois.title: Desert Ridge Border
pois.name: Desert Ridge Border
pois.desc: === Description === An Empyrean Stone Tower with a Ghost Wisp on the edge of the Falamar Hills. This location is usually dense with various creature spawns. === Route ===

pois.title: 11.3S, 37.6E - Empyrean Ruins
pois.name: Empyrean Ruins
pois.desc:
=== Description === A large Empyrean Ruins Site at 11.3S, 37.6E west of Yanshi with different portals and dungeons.
It consists of three Empyrean Three-legged Archs with portals, an Empyrean Platform with the portal to the Abandoned Arena, quite a few Empyrean Statues and the portal to the Colosseum

pois.title: North Yanshi Outpost
pois.name: North Yanshi Outpost
pois.desc: === Description === One of the old starter outposts where new arrivals to Dereth would appear. It was destroyed by Martine during The First Strike event. === Route ===

pois.title: South Yanshi Outpost
pois.name: South Yanshi Outpost
pois.desc:
=== Description === One of the old starter outposts where new arrivals to Dereth would appear. It was destroyed by Martine during The First Strike event.
This outpost is the starting point for The Writings of Jhong Mi quest. One of the dungeons involved in the quest is just next to the outpost at 16.0S, 47.2E. There is also a portal to Redspire here and a spawn of Blue Phyntos Wasps amongst Em

pois.title: Burun Ruuk Village
pois.name: Burun Ruuk Village
pois.desc: === Description === A village built by the Burun Ruuk shortly after they arrived to Dereth through portals in the Temple of Ixir Zi. The village itself is centered around the temple's entrance. The creatures here drop untranslated texts that are used in the Blackmire Lore quest. === Route ===

pois.title: Folthid Estate
pois.name: Folthid Estate
pois.desc: === Description === The Folthid estate is the home of Raxanza Folthid and her employee Felscuda. It is located northeast of Yanshi and south of Lytelthorpe. The estate has four points of interest: === Creatures ===

pois.title: Burun Fortress
pois.name: Burun Fortress
pois.desc: === Description === A huge fortress at 25.8S, 46.3E in the Blackmire Swamp near Yanshi, full of Burun. To the south is a destroyable Fortress Barrier. On the table just outside the Barrier, the Blueprints for a Burun Fortress can be picked up. === Route ===

pois.title: Imuth Maer Doquin
pois.name: Imuth Maer Doquin
pois.desc: === Description === A series of ancient Empyrean buildings populated by low level mosswarts and drudges located near the town of Yanshi. This was one of the first major points of interest in the game and even appears on the Ingame Map (See Points of Interest Map, no.48). Later on it was updated to include an alternative portal to the Wai Jhou Halls of Metos. === Route ===

pois.title: Fycheck Outpost
pois.name: Fycheck Outpost
pois.desc: (Rumor) === Description === An  abandoned Sho outpost. It was long unoccupied, until renegade Gotrok Lugians took it over. There was a lifestone in the outpost, but when the lugians took over, the lifestone was destroyed or relocated, and there is now one to the north. There is a portal to Eastham at the eastern end of the outpost. The lugians guard a Runed Chest (resistance: 200, tier 4 Loot). In

pois.title: Sho Roadside
pois.name: Sho Roadside
pois.desc: === Description === The destination of all Sho Roadside Portals. A peddler has established a shop here, and keeps a pet white rat. === Route ===

pois.title: Fycheck Ruins
pois.name: Fycheck Ruins
pois.desc: (Rumor) === Description === A large Empyrean ruin site with wisps, rats, zefirs, and undead. There is an unlocked runed chest (tier 3 Loot) in the middle bunker. The ruins are made up of two Empyrean Stone Bunkers, a Meeting Hall Style Building, three Empyrean Statues, numerous Empyrean Pillars, and an Empyrean Stone Tower.

pois.title: West Shoushi Outpost
pois.name: West Shoushi Outpost
pois.desc: === Description === One of the old starter outposts where new arrivals to Dereth would appear. Unlike most of the other outposts this one was not attacked by Martine and still functions, however, instead of appearing here new arrivals portal directly into Shoushi proper. === Route ===

pois.title: Rat King's Cave
pois.name: Rat King's Cave
pois.desc: === Description === Home of the Rat King. Complete all tasks from the Rat Catcher quest to be flagged to loot the Rat King's tail. === Route ===

pois.title: Festival Stone of Foredawn
pois.name: Festival Stone of Foredawn
pois.desc: The Festival Stones}} === Description === "The Stone of Foredawn lies east of Shoushi, near 75.5E, 33.9S. This Stone appears to be the only one whose attendant temple facilities have survived the depredations of time." -- Alatar Locke, The Festival Stones of the Empyreans
